# Encoding (IEEE 754-2008 clause 3.5.2), the predicates of clause 5.7.2 and
# the sign operations of clause 5.5.1 ("Sign operations"). Unpack results
# are kind neg coeff exp; Pack operands are neg coeff exp and its results
# the encoding and ok. The sign operations copy bits: they keep a
# non-canonical coefficient, a NaN payload and the signaling bit, so their
# expected results are written in hex where the character form could not
# show the difference.
#
# For Pack the overflow class holds the operands it refuses: a coefficient
# above MaxCoeff or an exponent outside [MinExp, MaxExp].

# --- Unpack64 ---

Unpack64 - exact 1.50 -> finite false 150 -2
Unpack64 - exact -1.50 -> finite true 150 -2
Unpack64 - exact 9.999999999999999E+384 -> finite false 9999999999999999 369
Unpack64 - exact 9007199254740992 -> finite false 9007199254740992 0
Unpack64 - exact 1234567890123456 -> finite false 1234567890123456 0
Unpack64 - exact 1E+369 -> finite false 1 369
Unpack64 - exact 1.0E+370 -> finite false 10 369

Unpack64 - underflow 1E-398 -> finite false 1 -398
Unpack64 - underflow -9.99999999999999E-384 -> finite true 999999999999999 -398

Unpack64 - zero 0 -> finite false 0 0
Unpack64 - zero -0E+5 -> finite true 0 5
Unpack64 - zero 0E-398 -> finite false 0 -398
Unpack64 - zero 0E+369 -> finite false 0 369

Unpack64 - inf Infinity -> inf false 0 0
Unpack64 - inf -Infinity -> inf true 0 0
Unpack64 - inf 0x7800000000000001 -> inf false 0 0

Unpack64 - nan NaN -> nan false 0 0
Unpack64 - nan -NaN -> nan true 0 0
Unpack64 - nan sNaN -> nan false 0 0
Unpack64 - nan -sNaN -> nan true 0 0
Unpack64 - nan 0x7c00000000000001 -> nan false 0 0
Unpack64 - nan 0xfe0000000001e240 -> nan true 0 0

Unpack64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> finite false 0 0
Unpack64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff -> finite true 0 5
Unpack64 - noncanon 0x6c7386f26fc10000 -> finite false 0 0
Unpack64 - noncanon 0x6007ffffffffffff -> finite false 0 -398
Unpack64 - noncanon 0x77ffffffffffffff -> finite false 0 369
Unpack64 - noncanon 0x6c7386f26fc0ffff -> finite false 9999999999999999 0

# --- Unpack128 ---

Unpack128 - exact 1.50 -> finite false 150 -2
Unpack128 - exact -1.50E+6000 -> finite true 150 5998
Unpack128 - exact 9.999999999999999999999999999999999E+6144 -> finite false 9999999999999999999999999999999999 6111
Unpack128 - exact 1234567890123456789012345678901234 -> finite false 1234567890123456789012345678901234 0

Unpack128 - zero 0E+6111 -> finite false 0 6111

Unpack128 - inf -Infinity -> inf true 0 0

Unpack128 - nan NaN -> nan false 0 0
Unpack128 - nan -NaN -> nan true 0 0
Unpack128 - nan sNaN -> nan false 0 0
Unpack128 - nan 0x7c000000000000010000000000000000 -> nan false 0 0
Unpack128 - nan 0xfe000000000000000000000000000005 -> nan true 0 0

Unpack128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -> finite false 0 0
Unpack128 - noncanon 0xb047ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 -> finite true 0 3
Unpack128 - noncanon 0x3041ffffffffffffffffffffffffffff -> finite false 0 0
Unpack128 - noncanon 0x6c100000000000000000000000000000 -> finite false 0 0
Unpack128 - noncanon 0xe0000000000000000000000000000001 -> finite true 0 -6176
Unpack128 - noncanon 0x77ff800000000000000000000000007b -> finite false 0 6111
Unpack128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e63ffffffff -> finite false 9999999999999999999999999999999999 0

# --- Pack64 ---

Pack64 - exact true 150 -2 -> -1.50 true

Pack64 - exact false 1 369 -> 1E+369 true
Pack64 - exact false 10 369 -> 1.0E+370 true

Pack64 - underflow false 1 -398 -> 1E-398 true
Pack64 - underflow true 999999999999999 -398 -> -9.99999999999999E-384 true

Pack64 - overflow false 10000000000000000 0 -> NaN false
Pack64 - overflow false 1 370 -> NaN false
Pack64 - overflow false 1 -399 -> NaN false
Pack64 - overflow true 1 400 -> NaN false
Pack64 - overflow false 0 400 -> NaN false
Pack64 - overflow false 0 -399 -> NaN false
Pack64 - overflow false 18446744073709551615 0 -> NaN false

Pack64 - zero false 0 0 -> 0 true
